# BucketDB

TypeScript document database. Uses S3 / Alibaba Cloud OSS / local filesystem as backend. No database server required.

## Key concepts

- `BucketDB` — main class, takes a storage adapter and a `dbPath` namespace
- `Collection<T>` — typed collection, returned by `db.collection<T>(name)`
- Every document extends `Document` which adds: `id` (UUID), `_etag`, `_createdAt`, `_updatedAt`
- `InsertDocument<T>` omits system fields (pass only your own fields)
- Optimistic locking: pass `{ etag: doc._etag }` to `update()` to prevent concurrent overwrites

## Package: @hold-baby/bucket-db

### Exports

Classes: BucketDB, Collection, MemoryStorageAdapter, FileSystemAdapter, S3Adapter, OSSAdapter
Errors: BucketDBError, DocumentNotFoundError, ConcurrentUpdateError, ValidationError, StorageError
Types: Document, InsertDocument, UpdateDocument, QueryFilter, QueryOptions, UpdateOptions, StorageAdapter

### Collection API

```
insert(data: InsertDocument<T>): Promise<T>
findById(id: string): Promise<T | null>                    // returns null if not found
find(filter: QueryFilter<T>, options?: QueryOptions): Promise<T[]>
update(id: string, data: UpdateDocument<T>, options?: UpdateOptions): Promise<T>
delete(id: string): Promise<void>
```

### QueryOptions

```
{ limit?: number, offset?: number }
```

### Query operators

$eq, $ne, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in, $nin

### Error mapping

DocumentNotFoundError  — update / delete on missing doc (findById returns null instead)
ConcurrentUpdateError  — update / delete with stale etag
ValidationError        — invalid input
StorageError           — underlying I/O failure
